title: Reduce macOS Git-query cleanup cost when only the exited root remains
outcome: Avoid the unconditional macOS snapshot pause in the common exited-root-only cleanup path while retaining a justified ownership proof.
acceptance: Measure the common zombie-only-root query cleanup cost on macOS and reduce avoidable repeated snapshots or fixed pauses without accepting live denied members or invalid root/membership observations.
Behavioral tests cover the optimized common path and retained refusal/descendant cleanup paths; document the supported ownership assumptions.
